notes.title: Steampunk Syndicate update!
notes.notes:
Thank you, guys, for you feedback! Today's update contains:

1. Timers in upgrades are removed. Now you can upgrade a card instantly
2. Annoying daily rewards are also removed.
3. Saved are fixed. (But please let us know in discussions if they are not)
4. We have fixed heroes now they are stronger.
